title: Shared clinical decisions
text: Healthcare decisions should be made collaboratively: the professional contributes evidence, risks and benefits, while the person contributes preferences, circumstances and goals. Model output is only information for that conversation.
source: NICE NG197 Shared decision making — https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng197

title: Cardiovascular prevention discussion
text: Assessment of cardiovascular risk factors can guide a qualified professional's prevention discussion. Tobacco, diet, activity, alcohol, blood pressure, glucose, lipids and body weight may be relevant; the appropriate measurements and actions depend on the individual.

title: Type 2 diabetes prevention discussion
text: People with diabetes risk factors can discuss appropriate screening and prevention with a healthcare professional. Family history, age, weight, activity, blood pressure and pregnancy history can affect that discussion.
